policies.text: Commercial tenure verification is achieved when a vendor documents an operating history of 5 years or more.
Data protection compliance is recognized for any firm holding ISO 27001 certification.
Master contract execution is recommended for a candidate with corporate vendor endorsement that records no more than zero critical cybersecurity findings annually.
A firm satisfies operational quality benchmarks by maintaining an annual defect rate under 1.5 percent, or by operating at least 3 regional distribution facilities.
Cold storage transport capability is confirmed for any provider with a refrigerated truck fleet of at least 10 trucks.
A catering vendor achieves premium service status by maintaining an annual food safety score of 95 percent or higher.

Qualification for the preferred procurement tier demands an EcoVadis sustainability seal, an average delivery latency not exceeding 24 hours per quarter, and annual liability insurance coverage of 5000000 USD or more.
Exclusive partner status is awarded to a contractor with high-volume vendor designation that provides 24-hour customer support.
Financial solvency approval requires an annual net income of at least 1000000 USD.
Comprehensive financial endorsement is awarded to a candidate meeting transport risk classification as low that submits audited annual financial statements.
Facility security qualification requires a licensed guard headcount of 30 officers or more.
Long-term agreement negotiation is approved for any enterprise that secures comprehensive financial endorsement.
Corporate vendor endorsement is granted to any entity that maintains supplier eligibility at the baseline level.
Primary vendor classification is conferred on any contractor with essential infrastructure capacity that has secured short-term bidding authorization.
Short-term bidding authorization is granted to any supplier that completes commercial tenure verification.
High-volume vendor designation requires primary vendor classification together with annual revenue of at least 20000000 USD.

Essential infrastructure capacity is verified if a provider operates 3 or more regional distribution facilities, holds a Tier 3 customs clearance, or achieves worker safety compliance of 90 percent or higher.
Supplier eligibility at the baseline level requires either ISO 9001 certification coupled with a credit score of at least 700, or an active EcoVadis sustainability seal.
Equipment supplier authorization requires an active warehouse lease of 5 years or longer.
Selection for regional distribution expansion applies to any contractor qualifying for the preferred procurement tier that maintains a delivery truck fleet of at least 100 trucks.
A firm establishes commercial operational stability when it shows an operating history of at least 5 years alongside ISO 9001 certification.
Transport risk classification as low requires a credit score of 700 or higher, no more than 5 quarterly safety violations, and an on-time shipment rate of at least 90 percent for the quarter.
